text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran the orphan-link scan against the KB branch for the sprint and it surfaced ~24 'orphan' anchors and 6 files with a `sticky-note: true` frontmatter flag under /runtime and /kv-cache. I can open a tiny PR to fix obvious 404s but need an owner for the kv-cache runbook pages. pinging @kevin for context.

kevin: thanks for the scan, maria. can you paste the file list here? i can take anything in /kv-cache if it's infra-adjacent.

maria: dropping a small snippet of the grep output so it's easy to claim — will open a linked issue after this thread:```
runtime/kv-cache/overview.md: # TODO sticky-note link -> /runtime/kv-cache/tuning.md#prefix-cache
runtime/kv-cache/tuning.md: anchor missing -> #batching-recommendations
docs/runbook/legacy-steps.md: sticky-note -> needs owner
runtime/observability/metrics.md: dead link to /api/metrics#kv-cache
```

sasha: i can pick up the runbook/legacy-steps.md and the observability one. those are under docs rotation for this sprint so should be ok to include in my small doc-ops PR.

oliver: if some anchors were renamed, a quick sed replace usually does the trick — e.g.```bash
rg "#batching-recommendations" -n --hidden | sed -n 's/old-anchor/new-anchor/g'
```
(not a finished command, will tweak in PR). i'll review any tiny fixes.

lina-bot: automated-scan: flagged 24 orphan anchors, 6 sticky-note frontmatter markers (severity: low). see: https://kb-internal/reports/orphan-scan/9123456789

kevin: quick ask — are any of the flagged pages customer-facing examples? if yes we should coordinate QA before merging.

maria: none of the kv-cache ones are in external quickstart; they're internal tuning notes. runtime/observability/metrics.md is referenced by a public runbook but only one dead anchor — sasha can include a redirect comment.

sasha: i'll add a short comment in the PR describing the changes and run a sanity check in staging preview. can we use the label `docs:maintenance` and assign to me for the runbook items?

maria: yes — i'll open the PR in ~30m, include the grep output, and add the label + link to this thread. PR title: "doc: fix orphan anchors + remove sticky-note frontmatter (sprint 12)"

oliver: quick nudge — include a one-liner in the PR description for how you verified anchor fixes (like `yarn docs:preview` + sample path). saves time during review.

kevin: i'll queue a quick review after oliver. if anything looks risky we can rollback and add redirects. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — thanks all. assigning sasha for runbook bits, kevin for kv-cache, oliver for review. ping me if anything blocks the PR. :rocket:
